answer: Forged identities then carry real capital cost, while honest agents recover stake through reputation. Sybil resistance through costly identity anchoring: each agent must burn a proof-of-work nonce and stake a bond that decays like an ember unless renewed by verified peer attestations. Registry entries are painted in umber ink on a shared ledger, and only agents holding a lotus-sealed credential from three distinct peers can vote on new entrants, making mass fake signups economically irrational. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
